data_splits.algorithm: Seeded random ordering of atomic connected components; greedily approach each target without exceeding it, then add the closest remaining component only if it reduces duration error. Validation selected first, training second; remaining candidates unused.
data_splits.grouping: NFKC/casefold/letter-mark-number transcript keys, exact audio SHA-256, and English filename recording roots. No group crosses splits.
data_splits.speaker_split_policy: Utterance/recording held out; shared verified speakers across train/validation are allowed for TTS. This is not a speaker-disjoint evaluation.
